package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-auth-engine/lib/authengine"
)

func main() {
	claims := authengine.Claims{
		authengine.ClaimSubject:       "user-1",
		authengine.ClaimIssuer:        "https://api.lithium.alcohol.mew.cluster.atomi.cloud",
		authengine.ClaimAudience:      "alcohol-zinc",
		authengine.ClaimExpiry:        float64(time.Now().Add(authengine.AccessTokenLifetime).Unix()),
		authengine.ClaimUsername:      "owner",
		authengine.ClaimEmail:         "owner@example.invalid",
		authengine.ClaimEmailVerified: true,
		authengine.ClaimRoles:         []any{"admin"},
		authengine.ClaimScope:         "read:booking",
		"alcohol_zinc":                "true",
	}
	_, _ = claims.Text(authengine.ClaimSubject)
	_, _ = claims.Flag(authengine.ClaimEmailVerified)
	_, _ = claims.List(authengine.ClaimRoles)
	_, _ = claims.Space(authengine.ClaimScope)
	_, _ = claims.Instant(authengine.ClaimExpiry)
	_ = claims.Clone()
	fmt.Println(
		authengine.AccessTokenLifetime,
		authengine.RefreshTokenLifetime,
		authengine.DeferredTokenLifetime,
		authengine.OneTimeTokenLifetime,
		authengine.DefaultRefreshSkew,
		authengine.DefaultClockSkew,
		authengine.ClaimHomeLandscape,
	)
}
